source_audit.finding: TypedMemoryRecord is an exact caller-declared binding to MemoryLifecycleState; it performs no UnifiedDB write, truth inference, retrieval or effect authorization. Any voice adapter must verify exact lifecycle/generation/payload/provenance identity rather than treating memory_refs as canonical writes.

Generation-4 ContextCompiler requires every selectable ContextItem to have an exact ContextCostWitness bound to the same payload digest and measured cost. Therefore interrupted heard-prefix ephemeral next-turn context cannot be admitted by digest/reference alone; it needs a valid cost witness or must fail closed.

GWT re-entry binding consumes exact already-valid WP508 witness plus WP507 uptake receipt and full broadcast/recipient lineage, preserving uptake state verbatim and minting no new GWT runtime evidence. An opaque gwt_ref string is insufficient authority.

Realtime re-entry is deterministic evidence over exact VoiceSessionCapsule lineage and does not mutate canonical state, execute tools/effects or contact providers. Late TOOL_RETURN and BARGE_IN handling must stay lineage-bound.

decision.new_unique_constraint: VSR01/VSR02 context admission must include exact ContextCostWitness binding for completed-output or heard-prefix payloads; bypassing this would violate the accepted ContextCompiler G4 contract.
